name: bar-chart
description: Bars standing on the bottom of the content zone, straight on the chapter field — no card, no axes, no grid. Each bar is a strip of paper (paper stock, soft contact shadow, seeded blue-ballpoint hatching); the one the line is about is haldi with its value circled by hand. Every bar's value sits above it in the headline face; labels 54 px, caption 44 px (put notes like "example" in caption, never a loose tag). Optional: prefix (e.g. "₹", default "") goes before every value, and a 0 bar then shows as a thin paper slab labelled "₹0" instead of a bare line. bracket (default false): true draws a pen bracket on the taller bar spanning the difference, labelled "+<difference>" (prefix + Indian grouping); a string sets the label text instead. bracketBars ([i, j], optional) picks which two bars to compare (default: the two tallest).
